subject: Request for Type II report copy, bridge letter options, and secure share
body:
From: Jordan Miles <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>; Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <audits@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Type II report copy, bridge letter and transfer options

Hi Lauren,

We're beginning the security review for Acme's procurement and need to collect Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for our vendor file. Can you confirm the audit period covered, and provide a copy of the report (redacted excerpts are fine if needed)? If a final Type II report for the period we requested doesn't exist yet, can you provide a bridge letter and an estimated delivery window?

Specific asks from our side:
- Final Type II report (PDF) or bridge letter if report not yet issued
- Management assertion / cover letter
- Evidence index or list of artifact categories you can share (encryption, access control, incident response summaries, third-party pen test summary)
- Preferred secure transfer options (S3 presigned, secure Box/ShareFile, or portal) and any required NDAs/BAAs
- Confirmation of the audit period covered (we're evaluating coverage for 2026 calendar year, but can accept alternate 12-month windows if you provide dates)

We also attached a short questionnaire (procurement-sec-questions.pdf) with a few clarifying items. Please let us know the earliest you can get the report or bridge letter.

Thanks,
Jordan Miles
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp

---

On Wed, Jul 21, 2027 at 10:03 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Jordan Miles <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Type II report copy, bridge letter and transfer options

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Happy to get this to you. Quick summary up front to save time:
- Redwood has a completed SOC 2 Type II examination covering the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
- We can provide a redacted PDF of the report and a management assertion.
- We can also provide a signed bridge letter (if you prefer a short statement of coverage and exceptions) for a limited additional window.

What we can share immediately (attached or via secure link):
- redwood_soc2_typeii_report_2026-01-01_2026-12-31.pdf (redacted where customer-identifying info appears)
- management_assertion_redwood_2026.pdf
- evidence_index_2026.csv (high-level artifact categories + approximate locations)

Typical artifacts we can provide on request (some items require a narrow NDA/controlled access):
- Encryption & key management summary (KM policy, KMS provider details)
- Identity & access control overview (SAML/SCIM config docs, least-privilege summary)
- Incident response runbook and a redacted incident summary for the audit period
- Penetration test executive summary (full report often shared under NDA)
- Retention & logging policy and sample audit logs (redacted)

Secure transfer options:
1) S3 presigned links (7-day expiry) — easiest for bulk files
2) Citrix ShareFile / Box — good if you want ACLs and a review workflow
3) Managed portal (we can provision short-term access) — for high-sensitivity artifacts

Access control / legal: for full pen-test reports or raw logs we ask for a signed NDA or a data-processing agreement addendum (we can use your DPA or ours). Bridge letter signature can be handled electronically (DocuSign).

Next steps for us: confirm your preferred transfer method and which artifacts you need. I looped Neha (Legal) and Karthik (Security) to help with NDAs and any technical redaction questions. If S3 presigned links work, I can get those to you within 48 hours.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations (Contracts & Compliance)
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Lauren — S3 presigned links are preferable for bulk transfer. A few clarifications:
- Please redact any third-party customer names from the report, but we do need the control descriptions intact.
- For pen-test materials, an executive summary is sufficient for now; we can execute an NDA if we need the full report later.
- Can you also include the HubSpot deal ID or procurement reference so our vendor onboarding system links correctly? (We reference vendor documents by deal id.)

If you can get the presigned link + index by Friday that would be great.

Jordan
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp
